tests.title: Member can complete a bank transfer checkout on a phone-sized screen
tests.goal: The main purchase journey works on mobile, where most shop customers are.
data: A non-quota product found at runtime

steps.text: Search for the product and add it to the cart
Open checkout, fill pickup details, select Bank Transfer and tick 結帳前同意
Dismiss popups and Proceed to checkout
Upload a receipt from My Orders

expected.text: Every button, popup close icon and field is visible and tappable without horizontal scrolling
Step 3: thank-you page with an order number

checks.label: Every button, popup close icon and field is visible and tappable without horizontal scrolling
Step 3: thank-you page with an order number

notes: One explicitly approved member checkout at 390x844 CSS px in Aside browser. QA member MEMy001164526; product C x1; Bank Transfer + pickup at 荔枝角. Order TXN0126103000013 (CRM 11068), HKD 600, confirmed. Marked TEST RECEIPT ONLY / NO PAYMENT MADE PNG uploaded once via My Orders; Payment Review verified in member summary and CRM. No horizontal page overflow: document/body 375 CSS px; required controls within viewport. No blocking popup appeared. Order voided and Canceled verified in both views, cart 0. No retry, real payment, or receipt approval. Viewport test only, not physical-device/touch or cross-browser coverage.
